environment.description: Same EKS 1.27 cluster but namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Standards in enforce mode). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-privilege-escalation' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec with securityContext.privileged=true OR hostPath volumes OR runAsUser < 1000. The container must run as non-root (UID 65534) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities. The Go binary is compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1 but the allocator behavior under non-root with restricted seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) means the double-free corruption cannot escalate beyond a SIGSEGV crash — the process has no capability to map host memory, write to host filesystem, or escalate privileges even if heap metadata is corrupted. The OOMKill and restart policy (restartPolicy: Always with memory limit 256Mi) ensures the crash is contained.
